name: Seed-to-Work Protocol — Unified Seed Management System
description: Complete protocol for seed evaluation, promotion from inbox to root, and transition from root to works. Replaces ad-hoc seed management with a structured, repeatable process.

seed_structure.description: Each seed file in inbox/ or seeds/ must follow this structure

fields.title: Short, descriptive title
fields.source: Source category (arXiv AI, arXiv Robotics, Hacker News, GitHub, TechCrunch)

promotion_notes.work_created: Work ID when moved to works (W-T-...)

phase_1_inbox.name: Inbox Evaluation & Promotion
phase_1_inbox.description: Single-pass evaluation of all seeds in inbox/. SR evaluates all seeds in one session.

steps.details: SR lists all JSON files in inbox/

steps.action: Quick filter: does the topic relate to Mandala?
steps.details: If not — mark as reject (skip further evaluation)

criteria.name: Novelty
criteria.question: How novel is this idea compared to what Mandala already has?

criteria.name: Feasibility
criteria.question: Can it be implemented with current resources?

criteria.name: Relevance
criteria.question: How relevant is it to current Mandala goals (Engineer Chat, Manus, Seeds)?

criteria.name: Impact
criteria.question: What impact will it have on Mandala?

rules.details: Leave in inbox for next iteration

steps.details: Add evaluation block with all scores and reasoning
Move seeds with action=promote to honeycombs/seeds/
Remove seeds with action=reject from inbox/
SR reports: N promoted, M kept, K rejected

phase_1_inbox.output: Seeds in root/ are promoted; inbox/ contains only kept seeds.

phase_2_root.name: Root Analysis & Work Selection
phase_2_root.description: Deep analysis of seeds in root/. SR reads full texts, checks external sources, prepares for works.
phase_2_root.trigger: When gardener says 'разбери корень' or equivalent

steps.details: SR lists all JSON files in seeds/ (excluding inbox/)

steps.action: For each seed: read full text
steps.details: Follow URL, read the full paper/article

steps.action: For each seed: check external sources
steps.details: Search for related works, newer papers, reviews, implementation discussions

steps.action: For each seed: fill work_analysis block

steps.details: Compare all seeds, identify synergies, conflicts, priorities
Choose top 1-3 seeds to move to Works
SR reports: analyzed N seeds, selected M for Works, K kept for future

phase_2_root.output: Seeds in root/ have work_analysis filled; favorites selected for Works.

phase_3_works.name: Work Creation
phase_3_works.description: Transition from seed to work. Creates work file in honeycombs/works/.

steps.action: For each favorite seed: create work file

steps.details: git add honeycombs/works/ && git commit -m 'feat(works): create work from seed SEED-...'
SR reports: created N works from seeds

phase_3_works.output: Work files created, index updated, seed files updated with work references.

evaluation_criteria_notes.novelty: How different is this from what Mandala already has? 10 = completely new direction, 0 = already implemented
evaluation_criteria_notes.feasibility: Can we implement this with current resources? 10 = ready to implement, 0 = requires massive external resources
evaluation_criteria_notes.relevance: How tied is this to current Mandala goals? 10 = directly addresses current priorities (Engineer Chat, Manus, Seeds), 0 = unrelated
evaluation_criteria_notes.impact: What effect will this have on Mandala? 10 = transformative, 0 = negligible
evaluation_criteria_notes.total_score_guide: ≥30 = promote to root, 20-29 = keep in inbox, <20 = reject

seeds_health_integration.description: This protocol integrates with seeds_health monitoring in scanner
seeds_health_integration.action: If inbox exceeds 20, SR should evaluate inbox promptly

notes: Phase 1 (Inbox) is a single-session activity: evaluate all seeds at once
Phase 2 (Root) is triggered by gardener request: 'разбери корень' or equivalent
Phase 3 (Works) follows Phase 2: create work files for selected favorites
Seeds in root with no work_analysis are pending deep analysis
Seeds in root with work_analysis and work_created are completed (archived)
